cards.title: The Winning Ticket
cards.description: He won the lottery. Then he abandoned his family and disappeared. Follow the paper trail to find the man who walked away with everything.

cards.title: People You May Know
cards.cover_tagline: She moved on. He never did.
cards.description: They dated for a few months in ninth grade. Thirty years later, he’s stalking her on Facebook. How did he find her—and what will it take to get away?
